batting.name: Vivrant Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Ramandeep Singh b Akash Madhwal

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c Ishan Kishan b Akash Madhwal

batting.name: GD Phillips
batting.dismissal: c K Kartikeya b CJ Jordan

batting.name: Ishan Kishan
batting.dismissal: c HC Brook b B Kumar

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Nithish Kumar Reddy b Mayank Dagar

balls.text: Jordan can't finish it off, Markram lays into the length ball and hits a huuge six over midwicket. 95 metres far. Markram was making room and got followed, whacked it off the length and SRH finish on 200 exact.
Length ball just down leg, hits flush on the pad after beating the cross-batted swipe. Ball deflects to short third
Slot ball angled away, beat the swing and went past fourth stump. Sanvir tried to swipe it over square leg, wasn't far from off stump
Misses the yorker, the full toss at shin height is down leg and helped across. Went between deep square leg and deep fine leg
Yorker just down leg. Makram cleared his front leg and tried to whip it across. Got it into the grass, goes to deep square leg
Markram makes rooma and is followed by the length ball on the leg-stump tramline. Whipped aerially to the right of long-on. He stops it despite another man converging.

Yorker knocks over Brook. Madhwal has two in two, finishes with a four-for. The crowd is thrilled as is the bowler!  Rohit gives a thumbs up. Brook went across early, got a searing blockhole ball curving in towards middle. He was a bit too far acoss. Once he missed the ball went through the legs.

Through the cross--batted heave and rattles timber. Length ball angled in after landing in line with off stump. Klaasen tried to launch it across, over square leg. Missed it completely. Rohit is jubilant right after
Nope, the very low full toss at 135kph around fifth stump is driven to long-off
Yorker on the off-side tramline. Klaasen goes back in the crease and jams it to deep-backward point. Madhwal has overstepped, Rohit grits his teeth
Shortish ball on top of middle, Markram stays leg side and tries to pull it. Hits it into the ground off the inner-half of the bat, goes to the left of deep-backward square
Yorker on leg at 133kph, flicked to long-on
Hard length just outside off at 137kph, carved off the back foot into the ground. To deep poin

Kumar Kartikeya might have helped him by running across from deep fine leg and stopping the ball from bouncing over. He has. It was a short ball that was pulled fine. Landed in the outfield, fielder ran to the right and stuck his hands up while on the move, managed to pull it back in.
Into the pitch at 140kph on leg, worked away in front of square. Along the ground for a single

Full toss is whipped fine and flat, deep fine takes it! Phillips was standing well down leg, got the full toss on the outer-half of the knee roll's left corner. He helped it along, got decent timing. But the fielder did not have to move.
Klaasen premeditates the reverse. Misses. The length ball hits flush on the pad and deflects to short third. Klaasen almost fell over to the right, managed to trod and then take off for the run
Length on off from around the wicket at 141kph, punched to extra cover along the ground
Yorker on leg, jams the flick into the ground. Goes to deep midwicket
Shortish ball at 136kph rises only to thigh-pad height. Phillips tries to force the pull shot, gets it off the sticker. Bowler runs towards midwicket and denies the run
Full ball on 138kph, punched off the front foot back to the bowler, who stops it in the follow-through

Edge off the pull goes to the keeper. Mayank is disappointed, looks up to the sky as he walks back. Madhwal points his finger up in celebration. It was a shortish ball dug into the pitch, angling away over off stump. Mayank cleared his front leg and tried to lump it across the line. Got an outside edge and the keeper took a dolly
Yorker outside off, Klaasen tries to thrash it through midwicket. inside edge takes it along the ground to deep square
Sweeps the quickie from outside off, got it flat in the air. Landed in the outfield behind square and it forces its way into the boundary boards.
Tries to angle the wide yorker away from the hitting arc, gets it on sixth stump and all Mayank can do is bunt it with the bat just over the ground. To cover it went
Pulls the length ball with limited timing again, Mayank is tiring. Ball goes to deep midwicket
Mistimes an attempted loft downtown. Gets it along the ground, long-off runs to his diagonal right to stop it
Makes room again, Agarwal tries to swipe across. Squeezes it behind square for a single
Mayank makes room and launches it down the ground. Length ball followed him, he got still late and went through with the drive for a 92-metre six
Length at the stumps at 93kph. Punched to long-off
Length on leg, pulled with limited timing. Goes to long-on's right, on the bounce
Length on off, cut to deep cover
Length ball sneaks past Klaasen's slip and leg stump.
Length outside off, punched to deep cover
Overpitched again, pumped downtown. Mayank made room and got the slowish ball right in front of his feet, finished with a step hit over the bowler
Stands still and gets a wide ball that's overpitched. Mayank goes on one knee and flays it over cover. Rohit has a chat with the bowler
Makes room and slaps the shortish ball following him at 93kph to cover
Short ball is pulled from shoulder-height, helps it into the ground. Gets it fine, deep fine has no chance as it races to the gap to his right

Vivrant twirls as he pulls, finds deep midwicket and his innings as well the 140-run opening stand comes to an end. It was a 136kph ball into the pitch following Vivrant, as he made room, he circled around and tried to impart as much power into the shot as possible. Couldn't and it sailed at an easy height to Ramandeep, running in front
Back of length outside off at 137kph, carved to deep backward point
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket. No one in the ring, quick running allows two.
A 132kph full toss outside off is lumped over the straight long-off area for a 88-metre six. Mayank was standing just down leg, had enough room to slap it through the line
Yorker down leg, Vivrant had cleared the front leg and tried to jam it through midwicket. Goes off the inside edge to deep fine leg

Slower bouncer is pulled from around head-height to deep midwicket. Commentators on air wonder if SRH could have reviewed for a no-ball, as it was the second bouncer. Mayank has a chat with the ump between overs. Replay shows Vivrant was jumping up and just outside the crease. Looks like it would have been no-ball had he reviewed. Eventually, the batters were too late.
Goes across again, gets a slower bouncer that, with tennis-ball bounce, goes over the head. Vivrant had gone past it and let it go
Heaved across for a huge six over midwicket. Vivrant stayed leg side and whacked the slow, length ball 91 metres far. That six was into the second tier pings Abhimanyu from the ground
Vivrant goes across and pre-meditates the paddle. The length ball outside off is slow and beats the shot
Run-out chance missed. Length ball was dabbed to short third and took off. Throw was quick and flat but didn't connect at the keeper's end

Yorker outside off, jammed along the ground past short third. Man in the deep runs to the left and dives but can't get there. Mayank has his helmet off and looks up with his eyes closed as he celebrates.
And Agarwal starts big. Clears the front leg and drives the full ball angling across in the air over cover for six
Legbreak on a length spins to top of off. Pulled to long-on
Fast 111kph short ball just outside off. Pulled to long-on
Down the track, belts the shortish ball outside off to the right of long-on. It was racing and bounced high as Jordan was running across. Looked to have burst past his hands
Vivrant tries the same thing, gets the low, slow full toss at 83kph o cover.
Dances down and gets just about to the pitch. Slaps the 83kph ball to long-on
Full, slow and wide. Swept hard, hovers in the air and it goes to long-on after landing around the edge of the circle.
Low full toss is driven into the pitch, it only picks up pace as it goes to the right of the bowler and over the grass to the straight boundary. SRH's hundred is up
Reverse sweeps a full ball at 91kph on leg to backward point. Along the ground
Flat length ball at the stumps, punched to cover
Shoveled fine, it's over the man at 45. Lands in the outfield, two bounces and over the cushions. Vivrant got on one knee and swept it flat in the air, a bit wider and well over the fielder
Length down leg, swept along the ground to Chawla at short fine leg. Fumble allows an easy single.
Mayank dances down and is followed by the length ball. Tries to mow it away but it's a bit too close, whipped into the pitch back to the bowler
Length just outside off, Mayank opens the face and stabs it to short third, who wasn't that far. Behrendorff there, came in and hurled it with power. Couldn't connect.
In-between length ball on off at 141kph, angles the bat and defends to deep point. Maiden IPL fifty for Vivrant
Length outside off at 126kph, cut to the left of deep cover, along the ground.
Length down leg, Vivrant tires to help it along. Misses, keeper dives and stops it
French cuts the full ball that was just down leg through short fine. Vivrant was making room and was cramped by the ball following him
Slower one is bashed away over midwicket for a one-bounce four. It landed on a back of length and sat up on top of leg. Vivrant stayed leg side and pulled it
Makes room and drives the length ball, while making room, to long-off
Makes room and is followed by the length ball on the knee roll, swept to backward square
Vivrant also charges, is cramped by the shortish ball spinning in to fourth stump. Pulled into the pitch off the inside-half of the horizontal bat. Goes to long-on
Makes room and pulls the length ball on leg at 96kph, to deep midwicket
Makes room and goes inside out over cover. Stopped in the deep. Ball was overpitched on the stumps.
Length ball at 88kph on middle. Mayank dances down and tries to slog it across to midwicket
Full on middle, punched back to the bowler
Length on middle and off, flicked to long-on
Vivrant dances down and Chawla slows the pace to 79kph. It's shortish and outside off, mowed across into the ground, to long-on
Length on middle and off at 89kph, nudged towards midwicket.
Back of length outside off, cut to deep point
Full ball swept to short third, Vivrant takes off and is sent back early. Quick throw to the keeper's left, bails dislodged by Kishan as he reaches across.
Overpitched and looped up, Vivrant goes on one knee and slog sweeps over midwicket for an 82-metre six
Pitched up at the stumps, whipped to long-on. Direct hit from the deep deflects off the stumps, goes towards the unmanned square-leg area. MI concede an overthrow.
Full on off, driven to the left of cover. Half-stopped with a dive, rolls slowly towards long-off
Full on middle, flicked to the left of square leg, who runs diagonally to the left, and keeps it to one
Mayank's standing just down leg, so has enough room to slap the length ball just outside off. It goes off the outside edge but snakes along the ground through the short-third area for four
LBW appeal turned down. Mayank inside edges the flick onto pad. Was a length ball on leg
Flat ball at 100kph on a fullish length outside off. Defended to cover
Fullish ball angles down leg, Agarwal tries to shovel it into the ground, behind the keeper. Misses, so does the keeper and they take one

Similar to the first ball, just that this time, he got to the pitch and sizzled the ball through the carpet. Fifty up for SRH, it's the best they've had, mentions Pommie Mbangwa on air. For the season of course
Fullish ball pitches just outside leg and comes onto leg. Blocked to cover
Full, wide and slow. Agarwal goes on one knee and tries to slap it over extra with the horizontal bat. Gets it on the bounce to long-off
Cuts a similar ball, maybe a tad wider this, to mid-off for a quick single
Length ball on sixth stump, beats the cut
Tossed up at 82kph, Vivrant dances down and gets to the pitch. He made room and swooshed it from middle stump back over the bowler
Makes room and short-arm drives it pretty much. Powers the full ball over cover and the ball races to the fence
Length on off, defended to cover point for a quick single
Vivrant charges and the bouncer angles away over off, his bat stays on the shoulder and doesn't come down from the lift.

Run-out chance missed at the non-striker's end. Mayank survives, Surya threw it from backward point and it just missed. It was a length ball that was tapped to the fielder. Mayank took a few steps down and stood still as he looked at the fielder. Vivrant charged in and he stopped too. SKY had ample time and threw it early, Mayank wasn't in the frame but managed to jog his way back after the throw missed the stumps. Rohit looks up to the heavens after backing up at mid-on
Launched over mid-on, too full and on middle and leg. Mayank drove through the line with ease, no need to check the shot when he can middle it with such ease.
In-beween length on off at 133kph, steered defensively to point
Mayank calls for a run and is sent back by the time the ball goes to midwicket. It was a full ball that was nudged towards the fielder. Mayank came close to halfway down, sent back wisely
Quick single attempted, throw goes to the non-striker's end. No direct hit. Looks like there's a late throw but the ball bas been backed up. Length ball over off, guided to short third.
Length ball is wide, Vivrant tries to cut it and misses
Charges and slaps the length ball from around the wicket through cover. It was coming into off stump, Vivrant make room and was able to free his arms.

Deftly guided between short third and backward point, who is a bit fine. It was a back-of-length ball over off stump, Vivrant went back and tapped it on the head. It pierced the 11-metre gap between the two fielders.
Flick is spooned but no one at midwicket. Fullish slower offcutter, lands on leg stump and angles away a bit. Agarwal chips it and it lands in the infield and goes to the deep
Length on leg, flicked to wide mid-on
Yorker on fourth stump, jammed to deep-backward point
Agarwal goes into Robin Uthappa mode, takes a couple of steps in front and pummels a cover drive to the left of Jordan at mid-off
Mayank makes room and slaps the slower ball over the bowler's head. It was full at the stumps, Agarwal swiped across and the bat turned in the hand a bit but it went well over the bowler.
Length on fourth stump at 140kph, dabs it to short third. May have gone off the underedge and went into the ground.
On a similar line, it lands on the full length and Agarwal misses the flick again
Yorker drifts down leg, Mayank twirls after missing the flick. Ball lands to his left and goes to the keeper.
Length just outside off, back-foot slap takes the 113kph ball to deep cover.

Direct hit from short third at the striker's end. Mayank slid his bat, looks to have been safe. Sent upstairs. Replay shows he'd almost made it to the stumps. The ball was pitched up and angling down. Vivrant was beaten on the straight drive, it went off the pad to short third.
Down the track and makes room, can't access the length ball around fifth stump. Vivrant tried to slap it over point again.
Wide on a length, cut to deep-backward point
Green's appeal for lbw is turned down. Back of lench ball angles in and Vivrant tries to block it straight. Deflects off the pad to the off side. Ump calls it a leg bye, replay shows it was bat-pad.
Flick beaten and pad hit but it's down leg. Direct hit at the striker's end but Vivrant was well in. It was a length ball that deflected off the outside-half of the pad.
Fullish ball on fourth stump, Vivrant crouches and cuts the 136kph ball to deep point
Vivrant charges and gets cramped by the hard-length ball following him, manages to pull it with the handle close to his torso. Gets it to the right of mid-on.
Length ball just over the stumps, opens the face and defends off the back foot to point
Gorgeous ball on a length, moves away to beat the outside edge. Landed on a length around off, Vivrant tried to play the line and defend towards cover. Missed it.

Similar ball at 135kph, Vivrant charges like he's taking on a spinner and slaps it over cover-point. Half-volleys onto the cushions. The seam of the ball looks to have frayed. So there's an early change of balls.
Length ball pitches around sixth stump and seams away. Let go
Full on middle. No swing, flicked to mid-on

Green slogs it across to the leg side, doesn't middle it but gets to his 100 and MI stay alive. It was a length ball that didn't rise much, Green mowed it and leapt up with his helmet off, ran with a beaming smile
Green tries to dink it towards cover. He was running across and tried to pat it on the move
SKY moves across and tucks the length ball to the right of midwicket. He throws to the striker's end, ball flies off the edge and goes towards deep third. Luckily for Green it doesn't go to the ropes
And... he taps the length ball on off to cover. Single. David has his hands on the head
Green makes room and creams the full ball through extra. Moves to 98*
Full ball is pushed to long-on

Full on off, whacks an off drive along the ground to the left of long-off. Green wanted to come back for the second but is sent back. As Abhimanyu puts it, 'Green was sprinting for the second, SKY didn't even bother'

Beamer into the body, Green tried to pull it and it went off the top edge to midwicket. It was at waist-height despite Green's height. Tyagi had bowled a waist-high full toss earlier as well, so he is taken off the attack.
Wide full toss. Green swipes, this time it's an unintentional edge off the swipe. Goes along the ground to the deep-third fence. It went fine
Goes across and premeditates a sweep. Misses the fullish ball, it deflects off the pad to the leg side

Outside edge flies far or has SKY deliberately opened the face at the last moment? The bottom hand came off but it looked like SKY did open the face last second. That's a controlled outside edge. It looked like an off drive that went wrong but is actually an off drive behind the keeper. What an educated edge... Give it a PhD
Yorker outside off, SKY tries to kinda whip it late through third. Missed it
Wide and ful, driven hard into the ground to cover. Throw at the non-striker's end doesn't hit the stumps direct. May have made it given Green's long strides
Overpitched, short-arm drive over mid-on. It came at pace outside off, went back faster.
Short and wide, SKY slaps it with a horizontal bat. Finishes with a full follow-through, lands close to the cushion and rolls over
Drilled with power again. This time it goes to the wickets at the other end. Deflects to the side for an easy single

Nitish at deep point is unsure what to do and ends up letting the ball sail over his head at deep point. He was a couple of metres in front of the ground and it flew over head to his left. It was a shortish ball that offered width, was carved flat, off the back foot
Drilled downtown. Green made room and got a full ball following him, whacked it into the pitch and it raced along the ground past the bowler
Full and wide at 129kph. SKY reaches out and tries to slap it, gets it off the toe to cover. SKY's timing is not there yet
Wide on a length, cut to deep-backward point
Tries to slap the wide ball over cover too hard. Gets it from the off-side tramline off the bottom to midwicket
Dances down and lashes the length ball to long-off's left
Back in his crease for a back-of-length ball on off. Heaved across to deep square leg
Thick inside edge off the attempted straight drive takes the length ball on off to square leg
Full on off at 117kph, driven to long-off
Slightly short but well wide. Cut to deep cover
Sweeps the fullish ball to deep square leg
Length on middle at 85kph, cut to deep point
Length on leg, flicked to square leg
Overpitched on middle, SKY backs away and goes inside out over cover first ball.

Nitish flies across at point and takes a mid-air blinder! Rohit made room and tried to carve it off a length but it ballooned off a thick outside edge. Nitish went across to the right and threw himself, reached out with his right hand and, somehow, it stuck. He caught it mid-air and hid the ball close to the chest to ensure it didn't pop out after he landed
Pulled, deep midwicket sticks out his left hand but flies fast and flat over him. It was banged in but rose till about waist-height for the long Green. He hit it with ease.
Muscles a cover drive, timing is limited though. The full ball outside off at 130kph goes off the toe over the infield, stopped close to the ropes
Slow and full on middle, flicked to deep square
Short and wide, cut hard but goes to deep point along the ground
Pitched up, Green lunges and slog sweeps over midwicket. It was on middle stump, Green got on one knee and hit it 81 metres far

Appeal for a stumping. Sent upstairs. It was a back-of-length ball in the fifth-stump channel. Green was standing just down leg. Tried to punch it towards mid-off. Missed it and his back foot slid down but he is able to drag it back in time even though Klaasen was quick.
Free hit is full and wide. Rohit flashes and the top edge off the 141kph ball flies to the left of and over short third
Full toss is over the stumps and is a no-ball. Rohit goes across and was trying to paddle. Later tried to pull it fine, missed. Goes to the keeper on the bounce.

Dropped at cover, by Sanvir again! Pitched up on off, Rohit cleared the front leg and tried to loft the drive. Sanvir was crouching to the right, looked like the ball came too quickly, hit him on the ribs and fell out
Slower one on a fullish length outside off, pushed to long-on
Back-of-length ball outside off, pulled after stepping across. Gets it to long-on
Overpitched on off, launched over mid-off to bring up Rohit's fifty
Short ball follows Rohit, he tries to launch into a pull. Misses
Length outside off, swept fiercely along the ground to deep-forward square
Tries to slog sweep, gets the length ball off the lower-half of the horizontal bat to deep square
Slapped off a length, just outside off and gets it through mid-off for four more
Shortish ball on fourth stump, chopped off the underedge to cover. Green was sent back after taking a few steps forward but took time to cut off the momentum
Given a bit of air but the length ball is still 94kph. Slapped from sixth stump to cover
Length on fourth stump at 95kph, driven off the back foot to point. Rohit may have rolled his angle while trying to turn
Short and wide, Green cuts it from the off-side tramline to cover.
Yorker around seventh stump, Rohit jams it with a horizontal bat to backward point

Mid-on and mid-off are up, so Rohit launches a straight-batted skier, gets past 11000 T20 runs. It was full and Rohit went through with the shot, its height was 40 metres at max. Mid-off and mid-on ran back but it was well into the outfield, too far for them.
Short ball is gloved, the pull unwittingly takes it over the keeper. Umran's covering his mouth with his elbow in frustration as the crowd cheer
Tyagi pushes the ball across in front of the boundary cushion while sliding, he walks across but is not sure when to pick it up. Eventually he's too late. It was a length ball that Rohit pulled fine,
Length ball charges in at 144kph, Green tries to clip it away. May have gotten an inside edge, goes off the pad towards cover

MI's hundred is up with a full, wide ball that's slapped to long-off. Vivrant's gotten cramps from the last few balls and is limping away now. He''s wringing and wrenching despite the support he's getting from 3-4 folks
Green brings up a 20-ball fifty with a straight slog sweep. He got on one knee and swiped at the full, wide ball. It was like a flat bat but from lower. Green raises his bat
Length outside off, tries to power a pull. Gets it with limited timing to long-on
Length ball lands close to the off-side tramline and curves away further. Let go

That's a moon ball, baby ball, call it what you want, Rohit would like that every time. Slow, high full toss at shoulder-height dipped after going over the eyeline. Rohit munched it over square leg for a huge six. No-ball as well
Even slower. Full and wide at 79kph, deiven to deep cover
Slows down the legbreak and gets spin. Length ball lands around seventh stump and goes away, Rohit waits and bunts to backward point
Length on fourth at 96kph, cut to deep cover
Short ball doesn't bounce much. The 140kph ball follows Green, making room, hits on the hip and goes to the off side
Length on top of middle at 140kph. Green stays leg side and defends with a straight bat. Ball goes into the ground and back onto his wrist. Umran charges to deny a quick single
Angles in and the 141kph back-of-length ball is helped off the pad. Tyagi races to the right and slides across to keep it to one
Length on middle. Green goes leg side and opens the face to defend to point
Rohit's hopping as he pulls the back-of-length ball at the thigh pad, to deep square leg
Ball flies past the flying fielder at deep square. Back of length ball around waist-height, pulled across. Phillips charges from deep-backward square and leapt in the air. Ball was out of reach
Full on leg, beats the slog sweep. Deflects off the pad towards cover
Makes room and pulls from middle stump over midwicket, fifty stand up! It was on a back of length, coming at stump-top height. Green dragged it across for an 86-metre six
Backs away and drives the full ball to cover from off stump
Pumped down the ground. Overpitched on middle and leg and the 83kph ball is too slow to trouble him. It's another step-hit. A drive with full extension for an 84-metre six
Full on leg, Green stays leg side and drives to cover. Practises the straighter drives after
Overpitched on the stumps at 90kph, flicked to deep midwicket
SImilar ball, Green uses the width and cuts it through cover. Four more. Green still going at 300 strike rate

Clubbed past the bowler, maybe Tyagi got hands on it in the follow-through but it went through his left. No chance for mid-off. Green made room and slapped the shortish ball outside off. Didn't get all of it but it went flat to the left of Tyagi's flank. It burst through the fingers and had enough pace to go to the fence
Short outside off, doesn't bounce much. Guided from around waist-height to deep third
Full and wide, Green crouches and lunges across to slap it to cover
Tyagi's pace works against him as the top edge off Green's cut flies over short third. Clears the boundary too. What's worse, Tyagi has overstepped. MI's fifty is up. Green's strike rate is 300
Rohit tries to muscle the off drive, ball hovers and fizzles to the left of the bowler. Stopped by mid-off to the right. 150 and 148kph balls to start the over
Rohit took a step across and tried to slap the length ball over the off-side tramline. Beaten
Dances down and pulls the shortish ball flat over midwicket for 75-metre six

Back-tracking catch dropped at midwicket by Sanvir! Length ball at the thigh pad had Rohit try and launch over cow corner. It went high and the fielder seemed to have gotten there. He tried to take it over his left shoulder but closed his palms too early and the ball slid onto the grass.
Back of length ball at 132kph just outside off is punched to deep cover
Wristy cut is beaten. Around a back of length it landed before going just outside off, Green crouched and tried to chop it. Missed
Length just outside off, punched to cover
Pulls a short ball that doesn't rise much. Hits it from fourth stump just under waist-height. Bat turns and ball goes to deep-backward square. Rohit is frustrated on missing out
Step hit over mid-on. Overpitched ball curved in right in front of Green who was making room, he just drove through the line and over the in-field
Dances down and tries to mow the back-of-length ball. Bat turns in, inside the hand and ball fizzles to deep square leg
Makes room with a couple of quick, late steps and tries to belt the length ball square on the off side. Underedge takes it to the leg side
Overpitched on fourth stump, pushed to cover
Shortish ball just outside off at 91kph is cut. It went to the right of point, too fast for the fielder. Rohit did well to back away and make a bit of extra room
Length on off, punched to cover
Pitched up, Green's standing down leg and gets it right next to him. Punches it into the ground, races past mid-on's left for four

Kishan balloons a pull, Brook dives at midwicket and takes it Shortish ball just outside off had Kishan swivel to try and power it. It hit low on the sticker and flew to the left of Brook, who dove across and took a good, low catch

A bit of hesitation in running, Kishan charges and slides the bat in. Just made it. Rohit was making room and got a length ball to his right. He was jumping as he opened the face and defended to short third, who sent in a throw at the striker's end
Knuckle ball goes over the stumps. It landed on a length and Rohit was on one knee, tried to lift it with a sweep, the ball bounced just over the stumps despite landing on the fuller side of length
Helps it in the air, deep square runs in and gets it on the bounce. It was a length ball at the legs
Bhuvi swings it away, Rohit tries to launch it over mid-off. Gets a thick outside edge to get the length ball around sixth stump to deep third
Slower one is wide around a length and Kishan shapes to swing across before pulling out of the shot.
Length ball at 130kph swings in and gets some extra bounce - at least more than what Kishan expected. Batter tried to push it with a straight bat, went off the sticker to mid-on
Slower one into the pitch is bunted, Kishan checked the shot having shaped for the pull. It went from outside off to midwicket
Shortish ball angles away, allows width for Kishan to cut. He rose well but hit it to the fielder
Jumps and helps the back of length ball curving in fine. Short fine leaps to the left but it races away past him
Back-foot flick is punchy and travels well over the backward-square boundary. It was on a length on top of the pad, Kishan went back in the crease and hit it 77 metres far
Thick outside edge off the attempted punch towards cover. Length ball swung away and found the edge. Went to the right of short third, along the ground
Hoops away after landing on a fullish length outside off. Left alone
Pitches just outside leg but Bhuvi managed to swing it away. The length ball is blocked towards cover
Leading edge off the flick goes over point. Stopped in the outfield. It was overpitched on the fourth-stump channel, Kishan tried to whip it away
Length on off stump, blocked to point. Kishan takes off and is sent back, no direct hit at the striker's end
